summary: Frontend retest after Sidebar.jsx syntax fix. App compiles and loads. Analyst login works (redirects to '/' which IS the Dashboard route per Sidebar code). Operational dashboard renders all 6 stat tiles + 4 charts + team filter. Findings queue-toggle, bulk-bar with reassign + status controls all work. Admin/assignment-rules shows 5 rules + add form + apply button. Admin/ownership renders 12 rows with hostname/team/confidence bars/rationale. Two minor spec-vs-implementation mismatches found around data-testid naming — non-blocking.
passed: /login page loads (compile error from previous iteration is fixed)
Analyst login (analyst@vulnops.io / analyst123) succeeds; lands on Dashboard (route '/')
Sidebar visible with nav-operational, nav-dashboard, nav-findings, nav-tickets, nav-exceptions, nav-admin etc.
/operational renders all 6 stat tiles (Open Total=77, MTTR=11.4d, Reopen Rate=14.3%, Reopened Open=3, Scan Coverage=83.3%, Active Exceptions=0)
/operational renders all 4 charts (Aging Buckets, Overdue by Severity, Top Assignees/Teams, Throughput) — 6 recharts SVGs detected
/findings queue-toggle, queue-mine, queue-all all present; clicking queue-all loads more rows
Findings bulk-bar: selecting 2 rows shows bulk-bar with bulk-assignee, bulk-assign-apply, and bulk-update-status controls
/admin/assignment-rules table shows 5 rule rows; rule-name, rule-value, rule-team, rule-add form fields present; apply-rules button in header
/admin/ownership renders 12 rows with hostname, env, platform, criticality, owner team, confidence bar (visible as % bar), and rationale text

failed.issue: Spec expected sidebar to contain data-testid 'nav-rules' and 'nav-ownership' as top-level items. Sidebar.jsx exposes only nav-admin (the Rules/Ownership pages are reached via /admin/* routes, not top-level nav).
failed.evidence: grep on Sidebar.jsx: only nav-dashboard, nav-operational, nav-findings, nav-tickets, nav-exceptions, nav-assets, nav-products, nav-engagements, nav-integrations, nav-imports, nav-reports, nav-admin. No nav-rules or nav-ownership testids. Routes still work via direct URL.

failed.issue: Spec expected data-testid attributes like op-tile-open-total, op-tile-mttr, op-chart-aging etc. Only op-team-filter has a data-testid; tiles and charts render correctly but lack testids for automation.
